claims.statement: The Commission's AI Act pages describe documentation, logging, risk, oversight, robustness, and related obligations for covered systems, creating an evidence-production event; which target clients are in scope and when must be verified case by case.
The proposed payer is a consultancy already billing clients for compliance delivery; willingness to license an external Polish kit and the per-dossier royalty are unverified.
The founder can independently author and own original software and explanatory structure while linking to public legal sources; any copied standards content requires separate permission or license.
The Commission reports ongoing AI Act standardization work, so the evidence kit must expose version provenance and cannot claim that a draft standard guarantees conformity.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Consultancy owner, practice lead, or delivery director
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Adviser-neutral white labeling, version provenance, export quality, and lower per-client setup time must resist bundling
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns consultancy license relationships; consultancy owns its end-client relationship
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Direct adviser outreach, auditor partnerships, and professional education channels

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Founder-led adviser demos and training partnerships; target covered by first-year base license
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Annual license prepaid; dossier royalties billed monthly or sold in prepaid blocks
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 75-90% before specialist legal-update cost; unvalidated
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Onboarding, template configuration, change notes, and bounded technical support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Specialist legal review, standards licenses, cyber controls, professional insurance, and localization
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 3000-12000 PLN annual adviser license plus 300-900 PLN per active or exported dossier
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Hosting, model-assisted checks, document generation, and payment processing

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Large governance platforms, law firms, consultancies, and standards publishers can localize templates or bundle them with advice
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Each new client compliance dossier is an existing billable consulting event; missing or stale evidence creates measurable rework and review findings
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: A new AI client engagement, repeated template rework, an audit finding, or a regulatory effective-date change
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual license renewal and each new or exported dossier

contrary_evidence: The official framework and effective dates remain subject to policy and implementation changes, making static templates fragile.
Consultancies may prefer their proprietary methods and resist paying a recurring royalty.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Independent authorship with written IP assignment to the founder company; third-party standards are linked or separately licensed, never copied without rights
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell direct self-service licenses and use only public legal texts or separately licensed standard references
critical_control_point.current_owner: Founder company for original authored expression and code; public law and standards remain owned or controlled by their issuers
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns consultancy license relationships; consultancy owns its end-client relationship
critical_control_point.duration: Copyright and trade-secret term, subject to continuous maintenance
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The founder can create and own original software and explanatory materials using public law; this grants no ownership of legislation, standards, advisers' clients, or client evidence.
critical_control_point.renewal: Customer licenses renew annually; owned IP itself does not require renewal
critical_control_point.subject: Original Polish AI evidence schema, validation logic, update mappings, and export software

economics.acquisition_route: Direct adviser licensing, auditor partnerships, and professional training channels
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: 1000 adviser licenses averaging 7000 PLN plus 10000 dossiers at 500 PLN imply 12m PLN annual revenue; a 5m PLN founder outcome requires trusted updates and internationalizable licensing
economics.founder_time: Three to five hours daily with scheduled release cycles and external legal review, not bespoke client advice
economics.gross_margin_basis: Reusable licensed schema and software, with specialist review amortized across advisers
economics.payback: Target CAC recovery from the prepaid first-year base license; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 3000-12000 PLN annual license plus 300-900 PLN per active or exported dossier
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual regulatory updates and repeated adviser client dossiers

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Consented anonymous completeness failures and change mappings improve templates while adviser-specific client data stays segregated
fingerprint.customer: Polish compliance, quality-management, cybersecurity, and data-protection consultancies serving AI providers and deployers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct licensing to advisers, auditor partnerships, and professional training channels
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: White-label Polish evidence taxonomy, versioned questionnaires, validation rules, cited change feed, and export pack licensed per consultancy and dossier
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Consultancy pays an annual license and a royalty when it opens or exports a client dossier
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A consultancy begins an AI governance or conformity-readiness engagement and must gather traceability, risk, data, oversight, and technical-documentation evidence consistently

founder_fit: AI-system literacy and structured evidence design align with data-science experience
Licensing is more automatable than bespoke compliance consulting
Version coverage, dossier completion, and reviewer findings are measurable
Professional-channel distribution avoids continuous on-camera promotion
risks: Stale guidance could cause material client noncompliance
Users may treat a completeness check as legal or conformity certification
Large governance suites can localize quickly
Legal-update workload may exceed a part-time founder schedule

structure.commercial_archetype: Business-to-business content-and-software license with per-dossier royalty
structure.control_point: Founder-owned copyright and trade-secret implementation of the Polish evidence schema and export engine
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate regulatory interpretation and timely adaptation to final standards and guidance

thesis: Own a continuously maintained Polish-language evidence schema, control library, and client-ready export engine, then license it to compliance advisers per active AI-system dossier rather than selling open-ended legal consulting.
title: Polish AI Evidence-Kit License for Compliance Advisers
uncertainties: Number of Polish adviser firms with repeated relevant dossiers
Final timing and scope for each high-risk use case
Rights and cost to reference standards in a commercial product
Boundary between software tooling and legal assurance
